merged.title: fix(rac2): PAL and v2.00 call the right level hooks from their own C
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** #545 was merged without its last commit. PAL crashes on levels 17 and 19 (a moby grid read at 0x023408C0 / 0x0291EB20). PAL's and v2.00's own C call level hooks by readable names (`stub_empty_17`), and the table sent those names to the hook the v1.01 callers pair, 8 bytes off the one the disc calls. 20 PAL files and 19 v2.00 files were affected.

**After:** those names go to the hook the release's catalogue (and its executable) calls.

**How:** `release.py` units map the readable names of the hooks in the release's own files as their catalogue does, and `Release.text` renames those names in the file. PAL and v2.00 tables updated; a test in `test_release.py`.

**Tested:** every hook call of the PAL and v2.00 own C checked against the disc's executable (0 wrong). PAL disc build: L17 and L19 crashed before, now all 27 levels run 2500 frames, and title > New Game > level 0 works. v2.00 builds. test_release, the hostgen suite, parity (0 problems), check_versions, conventions.

merged.title: feat(launcher): --update-mods beside --play updates the mods first
merged.author: Promises
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

- **`--update-mods` beside `--play` (or a game's flag such as `--rac1`).** The start first puts in the mod updates the Play button puts in by itself, then plays. A Steam entry or shortcut can run `openrac-launcher --play rac1-ntsc --update-mods` and keep its mods current without the window.
- **Fix:** while a `--play` start updates or its game runs, the page's own auto-update leaves the mods alone.

## Why

- **Shortcut starts never update mods.** `--play` starts the game from Rust in `setup()`, without the page's `beforePlay`. A player who only starts the game from Steam's library (gaming mode, a TV) therefore never gets mod updates.
- **The page could update mods while a `--play` game was starting.** It knows nothing of a game spawned by `--play`, which is no job of its: `gameRunning()` only looks at the job list on desktop. merged.title: fix(hostgen): stop on a six-digit name its level has no function at
merged.author: nickyyOO
merged.untrustedBody:
**Before:** a six-digit name in a rac2 level file (`func_2EEEB8`) is an address in that level. When the level had no function there, hostgen quietly called level 0's function at the same address. The taxi code (levels 6, 9, 11, 13, 18) ran `quaternion_to_rotation_basis` instead of `FastVecAdd`, wrote over the level's path table, and Boldan crashed when the rail ships started (after the taxi and the lift down).

**After:** such a name stops hostgen with the file and the name. The decomp fix is OpenRAC/rac2-decomp `fix/taxi-points-vec-add`.

**How:** `Program.level_short_miss` finds the case; the lowering adds a unit problem; `hostgen.py` stops on it. Only rac2 uses `bare_names_in_level_0`, so other games are not affected.

**Tested:** new unit test, all 309 hostgen tests pass. rac2 NTSC build with the fixed decomp passes; PAL and NTSC v2 hostgen without the disc pass. The old decomp source stops with the error. In the container the Boldan taxi + lift route crashed before the decomp fix

Tested: regenerated all 30 tables of NTSC, PAL and NTSC v2.00 from empty files. All 90 rows match the committed tables, so no table changes. Hostgen unit tests and conventions check pass.

opened.author: Promises

## What

- **`--update-mods` beside `--play` (or a game's flag such as `--rac1`).** The start first puts in the mod updates the Play button puts in by itself, then plays. A Steam entry or shortcut can run `openrac-launcher --play rac1-ntsc --update-mods` and keep its mods current without the window.
